nl_Literal_translation_en: For the next 10 seconds, the ego vehicle speed shall remain less than or equal to the applicable speed limit.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在接下来的 10 秒内，自车速度应始终小于或等于当前适用限速。
nl_Paraphrase_en: Throughout the 10-second speed-compliance window, the vehicle shall not exceed the applicable speed limit.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在 10 秒的限速合规观测窗口内，车辆不得超过当前适用限速。
